mutant.description: AC3's own difference control (attribute value suffixed -PLANTED on the first data-model-refused / data-model-case-reason element) and, beyond it, every visible text node of the rendered ASML and BABA pages rewritten to 'REWORDED TEXT' (th year headers kept) with page_facts_from_html re-run.
mutant.expected: attribute plant: facts DIFFER; whole-page rewording: facts EQUAL
mutant.observed: AC3 (b) DIFFER. Whole-page rewording: ASML EQUAL {FIGURES 206, CITES 3, ABSENCES 34, CASES 3}; BABA EQUAL {FIGURES 188, CITES 51, ABSENCES 31, CASES 3} (ad hoc run, not a criterion). Note: AC3's element is a <td data-model-refused> whose own text node is empty, so its (a) plants words into an empty place; the whole-page rewording is the stronger wording control. The reader treats data-model-refused as a boolean marker (value '' or 'true'), which is what makes the attribute plant move the facts.
